title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Juicy Peach Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Juicy Peach Nic Salt captures the lush sweetness of ripe Peach in a clean and simple fruit profile. Expect a soft, rounded inhale and lingering juiciness on the exhale ideal for those who enjoy mellow, single-fruit vapes. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod systems and vape pens. Available in both 10mg and 20mg strengths for smooth, satisfying nicotine relief. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
